amendment_policy.substantive_change_deadline: before the affected manifest or result is inspected
amendment_policy.implementation_clarification_rule: A code-only clarification is allowed only if the validator proves byte-identical materialized semantic IDs and arm assignments; otherwise a new protocol version is required.
amendment_policy.typographical_change_rule: Record old and new hashes and demonstrate no execution or interpretation change.

suite_gate.external_behavior_validation_no_go: Any required condition fails. Preserve all completed results and state the failed condition.
suite_gate.claim_if_go: A complete, preregistered behavioral exposure intervention was executed on CLUTRR and an independent executable semantic audit was completed on selected DeepMind Mathematics modules.
forbidden_even_if_go: The original CLUTRR paper model memorizes evaluation patterns.
Semantic overlap universally improves benchmark accuracy.
The external result retroactively changes the frozen quality-enhancement-v1 P3 decision.
The Mathematics audit supports a behavioral effect.
Pattern exposure identifies an internal memorization mechanism.

clutrr.claim_scope: Task-1 clean relational questions at relation length 3. The intervention concerns the benchmark's entity-invariant ordered relation pattern, not all CLUTRR tasks, lengths, noise settings, or language templates.

semantic_identity.name: ordered_kinship_relation_pattern
semantic_identity.representation: Ordered tuple from the generated row's edge_types for clean story edges, paired with the target relation label.
semantic_identity.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON array [target_relation, relation_1, relation_2, relation_3] with no insignificant whitespace.
semantic_identity.evidence_grade: exact for the CLUTRR relation-pattern holdout object; not a complete logical-equivalence test across different relation paths
semantic_identity.verifier: Reconstruct the ordered clean proof path and target from stored graph fields; reject any row whose reconstructed tuple differs from the stored signature.

normalization.entity_names: replace by entity_0, entity_1, ... using first appearance in the stored clean graph before tokenization
normalization.input: normalized clean_story + literal separator token + normalized text_query

materialization.duplicate_surface_rule: Rows with identical normalized input and target are deduplicated before allocation.

pairing_rule: Group eligible semantic patterns by target relation.
Within each target group sort semantic IDs by SHA-256.
Sort all candidate pairs by SHA-256 of the ordered pair.
target_selection.result_independence: Selection uses only semantic ID, target label, and row availability; model outcomes and train-test overlap statistics are unavailable at selection time.

evaluation.allocation: For each target pattern, use the first 200 rows in deterministic row order; the next 64 rows form the pattern's possible exposure pool.

training_arms.common_base_pattern_rule: Use only non-target semantic patterns, allocate rows round-robin over target relations and then semantic IDs, and take the first 22,720 eligible rows in deterministic order.

arm_assignment.bit: least significant bit of the registered SHA-256 seed derivation
arm_assignment.bit_0: pair member 0 exposed in A and member 1 exposed in B
arm_assignment.bit_1: pair member 1 exposed in A and member 0 exposed in B

training_arms.paired_slots: The 22,720 base rows are byte-identical across arms. For each target pair and exposure index, its A/B rows occupy the same paired slot. Slot permutations are identical across arms.
training_arms.strictness: For every target pattern, one arm contains exactly 64 training rows and the complementary arm contains zero rows with that semantic ID.
training_arms.label_balance: Pair members must share the same target relation and receive equal dose, so every A/B pair has identical treatment-slot label counts.

model.role: frozen lightweight reference model; not a reproduction of a released CLUTRR checkpoint
model.input_tokens: ASCII byte IDs after registered normalization, plus PAD, CLS, and SEP
model.output_classes: all target relations declared in the pinned relations store
model.implementation_rule: The implementation, environment lock, and source hash manifest must be frozen and pass architecture inspection before the first training run. Any mismatch requires a new protocol version.

analysis.unit_of_analysis: target semantic pattern within model seed
analysis.positive_behavioral_go: tau >= +1.0 pp and the 95% interval lower endpoint is > 0.
analysis.negative_behavioral_go: tau <= -1.0 pp and the 95% interval upper endpoint is < 0.
analysis.null_equivalence_go: the complete 95% interval is contained in [-0.5,+0.5] pp.
analysis.inconclusive: Every result not satisfying a positive, negative, or null-equivalence rule.
analysis.precision_gate: The 95% interval width must be <= 2.0 pp to count as credible external behavioral validation.

mathematics.claim_scope: Regenerated full-entropy train and interpolation streams for exactly two pinned polynomial modules. Results do not claim exact equivalence to every row in the pre-generated Version 1.0 files or to other Mathematics modules.

train.entropy: official full train range via modules.train(_make_entropy_fn(0,1))

generation.dropped_samples: log count and continue exactly as the official generate.sample_from_module behavior

semantic_identity.operation_scope: Module name is part of every semantic ID.

parser.polynomials__expand: Parse the expression between the literal prefix 'Expand ' and final period.
parser.polynomials__collect: Parse the expression between the literal prefix 'Collect the terms in ' and final period.

semantic_identity.alpha_normalization: Map sorted free symbols to x0, x1, ... before canonicalization.

canonicalization.polynomials__expand: Ordered sympy.Poly(sympy.expand(expression), normalized_symbols).terms() including every exact rational coefficient
canonicalization.polynomials__collect: Ordered sympy.Poly(sympy.expand(expression), normalized_symbols).terms() including every exact rational coefficient

semantic_identity.evidence_grade: exact within the selected generator fragments, conditional on parser and independent symbolic-equivalence verification
semantic_identity.independent_verifier: For every reported collision, reparse both questions and prove zero symbolic difference after alpha normalization; reject the collision if the verifier does not return exact True.

mandatory_outputs: CLUTRR interval width and precision-gate status
outcome_blind_order: run Mathematics parser and signature validators without inspecting aggregate overlap counts
